title: A little luck, a little silk
location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
summary: Questions by lanternlight. Three suspicious wagons. A forest that wants the horses.

scenes.title: A little luck
scenes.description: The caravan rests for the night. Merchant wagons with paired draft horses stand in a long line behind five seated gamblers. Lucien and Arietta sit together; Balerias plays too. Sulesdeg and Tyjit keep watch.

narration.text: The long caravan had stopped for the night. Along the parked wagons, Samardag called a game of Three-Dragon Ante.
Lucien and Arietta sat together at the cards, with Balerias playing too. Radecere brought a surprisingly substantial purse.
Sulesdeg and Tyjit stood watch without joining.

scenes.title: A walk through camp
scenes.description: Lucien and Arietta walk arm in arm past the lantern-lit wagons while the caravan rests for the night.

narration.text: By lanternlight, Arietta asked about Lucien’s past and the magic in his bloodline.
Lucien sensed she was concealing something. He could not yet say what.

scenes.title: An offering for the peryton
scenes.description: Balerias offers food to the caged peryton by lanternlight. Oyn watches from nearby, a step back from the bars. The merchant wagons are parked behind them.

narration.text: Balerias extended food through the cage while Oyn kept a safer distance.
The peryton accepted and stayed close. Something glimmered strangely in its eyes.

scenes.title: A note in the dark
scenes.description: Inside the wagon at night, Arietta and Zelina sleep behind an open journal and a healing potion. A translucent blue outline suggests the invisible Lucien as the Emerald Pen writes.

narration.text: Invisible, Lucien searched the sisters’ belongings and found a healing potion and a journal.
Its entries concealed familiar names behind descriptions. On the final page, he disguised his handwriting:
“I know what you are doing.”

scenes.title: Counting the wagons
scenes.description: The next morning, Aldrik rides past three Cult of the Dragon wagons, watching their stern guards from a cautious distance.

narration.text: The next morning, Aldrik rode past three Cult of the Dragon wagons. Six stern guards travelled in silence with each wagon.
He kept his distance and watched as he passed. Could one wagon be a decoy? For now, it was only a suspicion.

scenes.title: Out of earshot
scenes.description: Away from the caravan, Aldrik and Balerias walk together and quietly discuss the wagons.

narration.text: Aldrik and Balerias took a walk away from the caravan. Aldrik shared what he had seen and his suspicion about a decoy.
They agreed that earning the cultists’ trust might help them follow if the wagons left the caravan.

scenes.title: Under the horse’s neck
scenes.description: Giant spiders attack the caravan and guards fight them farther back. Lucien and Coppercoil defend the lead wagon as an ettercap lunges at its left draft horse. Coppercoil summons Coppergoat to charge the attacker. Aldrik hangs sideways from his saddle on the right and fires beneath his horse’s neck.

narration.text: Giant spiders rushed the caravan and the guards braced their spears. An ettercap lunged at the lead wagon’s left horse.
Lucien fought from the bench while Coppercoil summoned Coppergoat and sent it charging at the ettercap.
Riding on the right, Aldrik hooked a leg over his saddle, dropped sideways and fired his light crossbow beneath his horse’s neck at the ettercap.

scenes.title: The horses fight back
scenes.description: Off the caravan road, an ettercap drags a silk-bound horse across uneven, root-covered ground toward denser trees. Lucien stops it while Strawberry Three and Mo Two fight back farther behind.

narration.text: The intended prey fought back. Strawberry Three kicked; Mo Two struck another attacker.
Pounding hooves helped bring down a great spider.
An ettercap wrapped a horse in silk and dragged it over the roots, deeper into the trees.
Lucien killed the creature before it could carry the horse away.

scenes.title: The cocoon’s secret
scenes.description: On the same forest floor, Lucien kneels and cuts open a cocoon with a knife while Coppercoil, Balerias and Aldrik watch. Inside, a dead woman clutches a rolled scroll beside a silver cloak pin and scattered gold.

narration.text: After the fight, Lucien knelt beside a silk cocoon. Coppercoil, Balerias and Aldrik gathered around.
Lucien cut the silk with his knife. A dead woman lay inside, clutching a scroll.
The company recovered it, a silver cloak pin, and seventy-six gold pieces.
What the scroll contained—and why she had held it so tightly—remained unknown.
